author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
why: Caption identifies a colourised TEM of one central red Nipah virion that has budded from an infected blue cell. Yellow immunogold particles label viral surface glycoproteins; the central subject suits near-square framing.

author: NIAID Integrated Research Facility, Fort Detrick, Maryland
why: Caption identifies a colourised TEM of mature extracellular Nipah particles in red beside an infected blue VERO cell. Multiple clearly separated virions and strong colour contrast suit a full-bleed card.
